title: HarMoEny: Efficient Multi-GPU Inference of MoE Models
authors: Zachary Doucet; Rishi Sharma; Martijn de Vos; Rafael Pires; Anne-Marie Kermarrec; Oana Balmau
research_focus: MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Routing / Load balancing, Collective communication

problem_statement.en: Multi-GPU MoE inference under expert parallelism suffers from dynamic expert popularity skew across batches: a handful of popular experts receive a disproportionate share of tokens (up to 60% on layer 0 of Qwen), causing GPUs hosting popular experts to bottleneck the all-to-all synchronization and leaving up to 86% GPU idle time. Profiling-based placement strategies (ExFlow, FasterMoE) cannot adapt fast enough to the skew that shifts request-by-request.
problem_statement.zh: 在 expert parallelism 下的多 GPU MoE 推論面臨動態的 expert popularity skew：少數 popular expert 承擔過高 token 比例（Qwen 第 0 層可達 60%），導致承載 popular expert 的 GPU 卡住 all-to-all 同步，GPU 空轉時間最高可達 86%。ExFlow、FasterMoE 等仰賴 profiling 的放置策略無法快速適應每筆請求都在變化的 skew。

key_innovation.en: HarMoEny combines two lightweight techniques: (i) load-aware token rebalancing where a small metadata exchange (~4kB) lets each GPU deterministically reroute tokens from overloaded GPUs to underutilized ones at every batch, and (ii) asynchronous expert prefetching that overlaps loading the next required expert weights from system memory with current expert computation via a dedicated CUDA stream, achieving near-perfect load balance without any profiling.
key_innovation.zh: HarMoEny 結合兩項輕量機制：(i) load-aware token rebalancing，透過約 4kB 的 metadata 交換，使每個 GPU 在每個 batch 都能確定性地將過載 GPU 的 token 改派到低載 GPU；(ii) asynchronous expert prefetching，藉由獨立 CUDA stream 將下一個所需 expert 的權重從系統記憶體與當前 expert 計算重疊載入，無須任何 profiling 即可達到近乎完美的負載平衡。

key_improvements.en: 37%-70% throughput increase and 34%-41% TTFT reduction over the next-best baseline; up to 84.7% reduction of all-to-all waiting time; up to 9.1x speedup over DeepSpeed at 90% skew; asynchronous fetching delivers 5.5x speedup of expert loading on V100 GPUs.
key_improvements.zh: 吞吐量提升 37%-70%、TTFT 降低 34%-41%（相較次佳基線）；all-to-all 等待時間最多降低 84.7%；在 90% skew 情境下較 DeepSpeed 最高加速 9.1x；asynchronous fetching 於 V100 GPUs 上將 expert 載入加速 5.5x。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system paper; rebalancing closed token distribution to near-uniform per ECDF plots)
models_validated: Switch Transformer (12 transformer blocks, 128 experts per MoE block), Qwen1.5-MoE (24 blocks, 60 experts)
validation_workloads: BookCorpus, WikiText, WMT19, Random (synthetic), Constant (synthetic with controlled skew alpha in [0,1])

scope_assumptions.en: Single-node 8-GPU server with V100 GPUs and NVLink; assumes at least two experts fit in GPU memory (required for asynchronous fetching to hide load latency); token threshold q is tuned per hardware via a closed-form lower bound derived from FLOPS, expert size and PCIe bandwidth; evaluation uses static batching and reports mean latency rather than tail; experiments cover only Switch Transformer and Qwen1.5-MoE.
scope_assumptions.zh: 單節點 8-GPU 伺服器（V100 + NVLink）；asynchronous fetching 要求 GPU 至少能裝下兩個 expert 才能隱藏載入延遲；token threshold q 依硬體經由 FLOPS、expert 大小與 PCIe 頻寬導出的封閉解進行調校；實驗採 static batching、僅回報平均延遲而非 tail；評估限於 Switch Transformer 與 Qwen1.5-MoE。
